Variants.Content: Laugaritium and northern Danube households depend on harvests, animals, markets and exchange. Long assembly consumes retaliation prizes; reopened markets provision farmers and fighters.

Laugaritium households depend on harvests, livestock and river markets. Traveling followers need real food from this production; valuables still require a buyer and exchange. Long campaigns consume retaliation prizes; reopened markets provide food.
